title: 日本ダービーの後に・散華の歓び

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I am defeated—what tragedy! Oh, how I draw out the best in my opponents! To that effect, the race was a rousing success.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I have also found an adversary whose intensity surpasses the Golden Generation's, but she declines me! It seems running by my side is an honor too high.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, the winds of time billow my sails! Even without a worthy foe, the crowds roar for me. They yearn for the bell to toll and mark the passing of an era!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: So ring it I shall. The Golden Generation awaits at the Arima Kinen!
